title: Number of Active Government Mobile Applications
description: Monthly data on the number of active government mobile applications, including data on the number of apps published and shut down.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as this is monthly data.

fields.name: published
fields.title: Published
fields.description: [Integer] Number of new government mobile applications published in that month.

fields.name: shutdown
fields.title: Shut Down
fields.description: [Integer] Number of government mobile applications that were shut down in that month.

fields.name: active
fields.title: Active
fields.description: [Integer] Total number of active government mobile applications as of that month, derived as the number of published applications minus the number of shut down applications.

methodology: This data is aggregated from the transactional data on government mobile applications made available [here](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/government_apps).
caveat: The data represents applications tracked via the Malaysia Government Mobile Applications Gallery (GAMMA) only. As such, official applications not yet registered in GAMMA may be absent from this dataset.
